title: Completed RESPONSIBILITY ASSIGNMENT MATRIX Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed RESPONSIBILITY ASSIGNMENT MATRIX artifact data payloads (PMO-04.06.04).

responsible_r_definition.description: Definition: The role assigned to do the work and complete the activity deliverable.

accountable_a_definition.description: Definition: The single role with ultimate ownership, decision authority, and sign-off approval.

consulted_c_definition.description: Definition: Subject matter experts providing vital two-way input and technical guidance.

informed_i_definition.description: Definition: Stakeholders kept updated on progress, milestones, and decisions via one-way communication.

wbs_deliverable_and_assigned_raci_codes.description: Tabular mapping assigning explicit R, A, C, and I roles for each major WBS work package.

role_coverage_and_work_distribution.description: Verification that every activity has exactly one Accountable role and at least one Responsible role.

single_accountability_governance_rule.description: Mandatory policy prohibiting multiple Accountable (A) assignments per deliverable to prevent diffusion of responsibility.

escalation_and_conflict_resolution_proto.description: Process for resolving role overlaps, gaps, and decision deadlocks across project leads.
